SCRAPSHIFT / AUDIO PREVIEW / 15 OCT 2026

Sound that fits the weapon

Four proposals based on the actual weapon names and in-game artwork. Compare the current approved cyberpunk sound with a new, more specific treatment.

Preview only · No game changes or build. One representative attack variant per weapon. Pairs are matched by RMS energy with shared peak headroom; perceived loudness may still differ. In-game random pitch and mixer settings are not simulated. Nothing plays automatically.

Laser Gun

Clean energy pulse

The green barrel cell gets a focused, descending energy pulse with a tiny capacitor click and a soft electronic tail.

Rail Gun

Heavy magnetic discharge

The bulky powered barrel gets a low pressure punch, a sharp magnetic snap and a short metallic resonance. No wind-up delay.

Rocket Launcher II

Ignition + exhaust

The visible rocket and launcher tube get a mechanical launch thunk followed by rushing exhaust. This is the launch sound, not the explosion.

Lightning Shiv

Electric slash

The yellow lightning-shaped blade gets a fast cutting swish with several brief electrical arcs, kept short for repeated attacks.

Tell me the weapon name and which side you prefer. The original material pickup remains unchanged.
